caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark brown sculpted object resembling a fish with an elongated snout, prominent dorsal fin, and detailed surface texture. The fish rests horizontally on a carved rectangular base that features a pattern of repeating arches. The object is centered against a plain, light beige background with no other objects or decorative elements present. The details of the fish, such as its scales, fins, and the carved patterns on the base, are highlighted with careful shading. The only color present in the drawing is the dark brown of the sculpture and the neutral tones of the background.
title: Toy Fish
